birth.label: Year of birth
birth.hintEmpty: We ask so the app fits your age. It never shows on your profile.
birth.hintTeen: 16 and 17 year olds can join with a parent's approval. Next we'll explain what's different.
birth.monthHint: For this year we also ask the month; only the month and year are kept.
birth.sheetNote: Newest year at the top. You need to be 16 or older to sign up.
birth.invalid: We can't save this year of birth. Please choose again.

confirm.title: Before you continue
confirm.body: Because you signed in with Apple or Google, we ask your year of birth once. It's used to make the app fit your age and never shows on your profile.
confirm.failed: We couldn't save that. Check your connection and try again.

under.title: You can join Droblet from age 16
under.body: We can't open an account for now, and we haven't kept anything you entered. We'd love to see you here once you turn 16.
under.bodySocial: We've deleted the account created with Apple or Google, and its details. We'd love to see you here once you turn 16.
under.closedBody: Droblet is open to people 18 and over for now. We're still getting things ready for 16 and 17 year olds; we haven't kept anything you entered.

intro.title: Welcome! A few things will be different
intro.body: We set your account up a little differently so you can use Droblet safely at 16 and 17.
intro.parentBody: We'll e-mail an approval link to your parent. Until they approve, you can set up your wardrobe.
intro.photosBody: Full-length and face photos open after your parent approves, and we keep them for a shorter time.
intro.socialBody: Following, sharing, the store and purchases are off for teen accounts.
intro.adsBody: We don't send marketing notifications, and product analytics is off.
intro.adultBody: When you turn 18, your account becomes a regular account by itself.

parent.title: Your parent's e-mail
parent.body: Your parent gets the approval link at this address. When approving, they also choose separately whether to allow Try on me.
parent.label: Parent's e-mail address
parent.info: We only use this address for the approval; we never send it marketing e-mails.
parent.same: That's your own address. Enter your parent's e-mail.
parent.rateLimited: Too many e-mails for today. Try again a little later.
parent.failed: We couldn't send it. Check your connection and try again.

waiting.title: Waiting for your parent
waiting.body: We sent an approval link to {{email}}. The link works for 7 days; we'll let you know when your parent approves.
waiting.expired: The link we sent to {{email}} has expired. You can send a new one.
waiting.open1: Your wardrobe and adding pieces by hand
waiting.open3: Style profile and the weekly edit
waiting.locked1: Stylist suggestions and adding pieces from photos
waiting.locked2: Full-length and face photos, colour palette
waiting.locked3: Try on me, if your parent allows it too

banner.noneBody: Enter your parent's e-mail; some features stay off until they approve.
banner.pendingBody: Some features stay off until they approve.
banner.declinedBody: Photos and the Stylist are off. You can ask another parent.
banner.withdrawnBody: Photo features are off; your photos were deleted.

locked.title: Opens with your parent's approval
locked.stylist: Stylist suggestions open once your parent approves. Meanwhile you can keep setting up your wardrobe.
locked.declinedBody: Your parent didn't approve this time. If you like, you can send an approval link to another parent.
locked.withdrawnBody: Your parent withdrew their approval. To open it again, you can ask them to approve again.
locked.toast: Opens with your parent's approval. Until then you can add pieces by hand.

notice.approvedBody: The Stylist, adding pieces from photos and your colour palette are open now.
notice.approvedTryOnNo: Try on me: your parent didn't allow it
notice.approvedTryOnOff: Try on me: not available right now
notice.declinedBody: That's okay. Your wardrobe, pieces and looks stay with you. The Stylist and photo features stay off.
notice.withdrawnBody: We've turned photo features off. Your wardrobe and looks are still here.
notice.withdrawnPhotos: Your full-length and face photos were deleted
notice.withdrawnTryOn: Try on me images were deleted
notice.withdrawnLocked: The Stylist and photo features are off
notice.adultBody: Your account is now a regular Droblet account. Your wardrobe, looks and photos are all still here.
notice.adultSocial: Following friends and sharing your closet
notice.adultStore: The style store and product links
notice.adultNote: Product analytics and marketing notifications stay off; you can switch them on in Settings.

tryOn.needsParentBody: Your parent approved your account but didn't tick Try on me. They can turn it on from the approval page at any time.
tryOn.pendingBody: Try on me opens once your parent approves.
tryOn.unavailableBody: Try on me is off for teen accounts for now. We'll let you know when it opens.
tryOn.explainerPrivate: Only you see the image; it can't be shared.
tryOn.explainerPhoto: Your photo is used only for this image and deleted soon after.
tryOn.explainerAi: The image is drawn by AI; it gives an idea of how the clothes might look on you, not an exact picture of you.
tryOn.explainerParent: Your parent can turn this permission off at any time.
tryOn.explainerFailed: We couldn't save that. Try again.

discover.note: On teen accounts Discover shows the weekly edit only. The store, product links and sharing are off.
discover.editMeta_one: {{count}} look · Picked by our style editor
discover.editMeta_other: {{count}} looks · Picked by our style editor

settings.tryOnAllowed: Try on me: your parent allowed it. Your parent can withdraw approval at any time from the link in their e-mail.
settings.tryOnNotAllowed: Try on me: your parent didn't allow it. Your parent can withdraw approval at any time from the link in their e-mail.
settings.notApproved: Photos and the Stylist stay off until approval.
settings.analyticsNote: Product analytics is off and no marketing notifications are sent on teen accounts.
settings.photosNote: Only you can see them. Teen accounts keep photos for a shorter time.

teen.unavailable: This feature isn't available on teen accounts yet.
teen.shareDiscarded: Trying on a shared photo is off for teen accounts.
teen.creditsOut: This month's AI images are used up; they renew at the start of the month.

stylist.quotaDone: Today's suggestions are used · Refreshes tomorrow
stylist.limitBody_one: You've used today's {{count}} suggestion. It refreshes tomorrow — until then, have a look at the looks you saved.
stylist.limitBody_other: You've used today's {{count}} suggestions. They refresh tomorrow — until then, have a look at the looks you saved.
stylist.weekDone: You've planned this week · Refreshes on Monday
stylist.packOff: Suitcase packing isn't open for teen accounts yet.
stylist.packDone: You've used this week's suitcase · Refreshes on Monday
